## Goal
- Produce evidence-based end-to-end verification of deployments for `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`, including canonical GitHub, CI, Render, and live production SHA parity.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use only canonical repository `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.
- Never expose credentials, OTPs, passwords, bearer tokens, service-role keys, or personal identities.
- Do not paste a GitHub token into chat; use the private secret mechanism.
- Preserve local code; do not reset, overwrite, or delete approved work without explicit authorization.
- Do not deploy until OTP plaintext persistence is eliminated and focused OTP tests pass.
- Do not certify production without independently verifiable SHA-matched GitHub, Actions, Render, and live evidence.
- Final acceptance requires `GitHub HEAD = Actions source SHA = Render deployed SHA = live /version SHA`.
- User wants the audit completed end-to-end and does not want credential troubleshooting to block unrelated QA.

## Progress
### Done
- Live production endpoints verified:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/health → 200
  https://api.ivxholding.com/version → 200
  https://api.ivxholding.com/readiness → 200
  https://ivxholding.com → 200
  https://chat.ivxholding.com → 200
  ```
- Live backend reports:
  ```text
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  status=healthy
  readiness.status=ok
  ```
- Public chat smoke test passed functionally:
  ```text
  POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/public/chat → 200
  answer="The answer is 4."
  source="fallback"
  ```
- Owner-protected route rejects unauthenticated access:
  ```text
  GET https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-ai/status → 401
  error="Authentication required."
  ```
- Additional production protected-route probes consistently reject missing bearer authentication:
  ```text
  GET /api/ivx/autonomous/qa → 401
  GET /api/ivx/autonomous/ledger → 401
  GET /api/ivx/autonomous/credentials → 401

  GET /api/ivx/executive-layer → 401
  GET /api/ivx/developer-deploy/status → 401
  error="IVX auth guard failed: missing bearer token."
  ```
- Verification API CORS preflight passed:
  ```text
  OPTIONS https://api.ivxholding.com/api/members/verification/phone → 204
  ```
- Unauthenticated member route probe returned:
  ```text
  GET https://api.ivxholding.com/api/members/profile → 404
  error="Not found"
  ```
- Route registration inspection confirms member routes are primarily `POST` endpoints and have explicit `OPTIONS` handlers:
  ```text
  /api/members/register
  /api/members/send-email-code
  /api/members/verify-email
  /api/members/send-phone-code
  /api/members/verify-phone

  /api/members/verification-status
  /api/members/login
  /api/members/forgot-password
  /api/members/reset-password
  /api/members/profile
  ```
- Rechecked secure environment availability without exposing values:
  ```text
  github_token_available=false
  GITHUB_TOKEN=missing
  RORK_PUBLIC_GITHUB_TOKEN=missing
  RENDER_API_KEY=missing
  ```
- Local OTP/member-authentication hardening previously completed:
  - `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts` uses salted scrypt hashes, TTL, attempts, resend limits/cooldown, cleanup, and production durable-store fail-closed behavior.
  - Current source marker:
    ```text
    DEPLOYMENT_MARKER=ivx-member-verification-v4-secure-persistence
    ```
  - `backend/api/ivx-members.ts` binds member actions to verified bearer identity via `requireAuthenticatedMember(request)`.
- Earlier targeted validation passed:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts
  ```
  - **38 passed, 0 failed**.
- Began a new local regression command:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts
  ```
  - Output shows missing local owner-variable database configuration warnings, but final command status was not captured.
- Inspected:
  ```text
  backend/hono.ts
  backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts
  ```
  - Deploy-control actions include `render_get_deploy_status`, GitHub commit/branch/PR/merge/rollback operations, and owner-only protection imports.
  - `backend/hono.ts` registers `/api/ivx/executive-layer`, `/api/ivx/owner-ai/status`, and `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action`.

### In Progress
- Complete public production route, response-header, and access-control QA.
- Capture final status of the newly started TypeScript/targeted regression command.
- Test actual member `POST` authentication routes with safe invalid/unauthenticated requests and verify their rejection contracts.
- Audit local deployment/security regression coverage and AI primary/fallback configuration.
- Record a truthful deployment verdict separating live-service proof from unprovable GitHub/CI/Render provenance.

### Blocked
- No GitHub credential reaches the execution environment:
  ```text
  github_token_available=false
  GITHUB_TOKEN=missing
  RORK_PUBLIC_GITHUB_TOKEN=missing
  ```
- Private secret request remains unavailable to the QA process despite the user obtaining a token; the token itself has not been tested.
- No `RENDER_API_KEY` is available:
  ```text
  RENDER_API_KEY=missing
  ```
- Canonical GitHub repository metadata, default-branch HEAD, Actions workflow/job results, PRs, branch protection, and required reviews cannot be independently verified.
- Render deploy record, configured repository/branch, deployed SHA, and explicit Render environment-token state cannot be independently verified.
- No approved authenticated member or owner production session is available for registration, OTP, sign-in/reset/session, owner-route success-path, or Supabase-record verification.
- Live SHA `012bb088...` is not proven to contain local OTP/member-authentication work.
- Mobile/web E2E, Android emulator, iOS approved-environment tests, release builds, and SHA-matched installation proof remain unexecuted.
- Current `origin` is a Rork router, not direct canonical GitHub:
  ```text
  https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```

## Key Decisions
- Continue all read-only live, local, security, and route QA that does not require GitHub or Render credentials.
- Treat `/health`, `/version`, and `/readiness` as evidence that a live backend is healthy at `012bb088...`, not proof of GitHub, CI, or Render provenance.
- Treat production `401` responses for autonomous, executive, and developer-deploy endpoints as evidence of bearer-auth enforcement only, not evidence that their success paths work.
- Do not certify public chat as AI-primary while production reports:
  ```json
  {"source":"fallback"}
  ```
- Do not claim end-to-end deployment verification until canonical GitHub HEAD, CI source SHA, Render deployed SHA, and live SHA are independently matched.
- Keep token validation read-only and minimum-scope: `Contents: Read` and `Actions: Read`; do not log or display token values.

## Next Steps
- 1. Capture/complete the current local TypeScript and targeted backend-test run.
- 2. Test safe unauthenticated/invalid requests against registered member `POST` routes and document response contracts.
- 3. Complete public production QA: endpoint behavior, CORS, security headers, error handling, and fallback/primary AI state.
- 4. Run broader local backend/root test, lint, and deployment-security checks; document exact results.
- 5. Audit AI provider selection, timeout/retry behavior, persistence, and telemetry without changing production.
- 6. Obtain execution-environment access to a private `GITHUB_TOKEN`; verify canonical repository identity, `main` HEAD, workflows, and workflow runs.
- 7. Obtain approved Render API access; inspect service `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`, deploy history, repository/branch binding, and deployed SHA.
- 8. Compare canonical GitHub HEAD, successful Actions source SHA, Render deployed SHA, and live `012bb088...` SHA.
- 9. Execute authorized authenticated member/owner success-path and platform-release certification on the final matched SHA.
- 10. Publish either verified end-to-end evidence or an explicit list of remaining provenance gaps.

## Relevant Files
- `backend/hono.ts`: route registration, CORS, middleware, member endpoint paths, rate-limit review, and protected IVX route wiring.
- `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts`: owner-only GitHub/Render deploy-control operations and credential/runtime-value dependencies.
- `backend/api/ivx-members.ts`: bearer-token member binding for verification, profile, KYC, and related member endpoints.
- `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts`: OTP hashing, TTL, attempts, resend cooldown, cleanup, durable persistence, production fail-closed behavior, and `ivx-member-verification-v4-secure-persistence` marker.
- `backend/services/ivx-member-database.ts`: member/auth persistence and service-role versus anon-key fallback review.

- `expo/shared/ivx/access-control.ts`: shared authenticated request resolution and bearer-token extraction.
- `backend/supabase/migrations/enterprise_indexes.sql`: existing verification-code index; no confirmed table-creation migration.
